headline: Yuvraj #2 climbs 185 places on ARC-2, from 277th to 92nd

sections.text: Yuvraj #2 gained 2.78 to 34.86 on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, climbing 185 places from 277th to 92nd in the past day.
The team is now inside the top 100. Public standings are provisional, so this is a move on the board, not a settled medal.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
